physicalNotes: Radius 0.16317273 Jupiter radii from Lowson et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.527.1146L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract): 11,665.5 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.0126 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
